allowlist_rpc.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames allowed to connect to the GlusterD RPC service. Use * for any (not recommended in production).

extra_options.description: Dictionary of additional custom GlusterD options (key → value). Used for advanced tuning not exposed by other fields.

log_file.description: Path to the glusterd log file.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, or NONE.

quorum_type.description: Quorum policy for cluster consensus: 'none', 'majority', or 'all'. Set to 'majority' for production redundancy.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for internal GlusterFS cluster communication. Requires certificate setup.

transport_type.description: Transport type(s) for intra-cluster communication: 'tcp', 'rdma', or 'tcp,rdma'.

working_directory.description: Base working directory for GlusterFS daemon state (must exist and be writable).
